verdicts.reason: A keeps the can and circle together, but the rest of the layout steps down in a staircase with no shared left edge: the headline and body start at x≈255, the badges at ≈310 and the CTA at ≈370. The GLACIER logo floats on its own, centred, and the top-right quarter is dead space. B keeps a clean right-hand text column with a clear headline-to-CTA hierarchy, although the headline starts a little left of the column edge. Its key graphic is broken, though: the circle has slid down to the bottom-left corner, the can hangs over its upper edge instead of sitting inside it, and the top-left corner is left empty.
